comment: Pinned toolchain and deployment policy of the Python SQL frontend (package gendb_sql_frontend in this directory). The package runs from source; no GenDB binary embeds it. A host runs `<python> -m gendb_sql_frontend translate ...` with this directory as working directory, and the package reads the one AST encoding schema at ../ast/ast_schema.json. `python` is the default interpreter (resolved on PATH); a host may choose another interpreter or parser directory through the environment variables named in `deployment`. Whatever runs is checked by the frontend itself: a Python minor version or sqlglot version other than `python_version` / `sqlglot` is the refusal toolchain_mismatch, so documents only come from the pinned toolchain.
